overview: The Great Western is a St Austell Brewery pub with rooms on Cliff Road, perched above Great Western Beach in the centre of Newquay. It has open-plan bar and dining areas, a sea-view terrace and garden, and is close to the town's shops and restaurants. The building is part of a phased refurbishment running from 2026 to 2028.
surfTripFit: Its clifftop spot above Great Western Beach, with Towan and Tolcarne close by, makes it a walkable base for Newquay's town beaches, and dog-friendly rooms help travelling surfers with dogs.
